title: docs(pm-dispatch): merge main before landing a label PR when a new locale landed under it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPFKx9sEPgbmNpwJBY4DMwx)_

Fixes #31512

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在落地规则里加一条:新增或修改显示标签的 PR,如果它最后一次绿的 PR 检查之后 main 上又落了一个新语种的翻译包,席位在挂自动合并或入队之前必须先合入 main 并重跑检查。
- 为什么改:今天 pt-BR 和 ru 两个新语种包先后落地,压在两个标签 PR 底下;这两个 PR 自己的检查是绿的,进队列后翻译门禁变红,连带后面排队的 PR 被踢出 6 次。
- 风险与回滚:只改席位落地手册的一个文件,不动代码、门禁与仓库设置;回滚即撤销本提交。为守住行数上限,删了两行在别处已有原文的旧规则。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` 第 29 行与第 33–34 行(新规则),以及被删的两行(第 57、65 行旧位)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 landing-operations.md 为 102 行、上限 102、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `landing-operations.md` §入队与落地:
  - The stale-base branch of the queue-red disposition (L29, "基上缺已合修复 ⇒ merge main") now names the case: a new locale bundle landing under the PR, which reds the translation gates, belongs to that branch (re-running cannot clear it).
  - New pair at the end of that section: a label PR whose last green PR run predates a new locale bundle on `main` merges `main` and re-runs before auto-merge is armed or it is enqueued. This is an exception to the platform-readings rule that a `behind` PR enqueues as usual. "Label" means the display labels the two translation gates count, named by their `lint.yml` step ids `check-generated-translation-bundles` (L6361) and `check-no-new-untranslated-declared-labels` (L6378): platform-objects objects, settings manifests, spec-declared labels.
- Line ratchet: the file is 102/102 with headroom 0, so the two new lines are paid by deleting two lines whose content is already stated elsewhere. Nothing was re-wrapped, and every touched line is at most 120 bytes.
  - Deleted the `mergeable_state` `dirty` re-read before arming. The same file states it at the PR-open-to-MERGED read ("dirty ⇒ 当即合 origin/main 推新提交") and in the zero-enqueued check ①; `platform-readings.md` states "dirty 即入队否决"; the generated-artifact half is the next line ("非零 ⇒ 按 A 的固定序").
  - Deleted the post-merge `closed_by_pull_requests` read. `platform-readings.md` §闭合关键词解析 states it ("消费侧检查 = 合并后读 closed_by_pull_requests"), and this file keeps the open-card reconciliation line, which checks the same mis-close.
- Not done: the optional `check:i18n-coverage` derivation beside `check:i18n` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`. It is not a one-row change. The row's self-test pin counts the section's lines (`i18nHit.length === 3`), so that pin and the docblock on the two i18n entries would also move. The gate also needs a full `pnpm build` before it reads anything, which every platform-objects card would then pay. And open PR #31454 edits the same self-test file. A local run would also sit on the same stale base, so it would not have caught either red.
- An option the card raised, which is not written as a rule here: the repository setting "require branches to be up to date before merging" would also cover this. That is the maintainer's call.

## Tests

None: this is a prose rule in a `.claude/**` reference, with no tested behaviour to ablate.

## Acceptance notes

- Evidence for the cause is on the card: the seat's premise reading (comment 6721491029), the dev report, and the triage retriage answer. #31440 (pt-BR) landed after #31435's last green run, and the 08:40Z group went red. #31466 (ru) landed after #31448's last green run, and the 11:11Z group went red.
- `platform-readings.md` L88 ("behind 的 PR 照常入队 … ⛔ 不为它先发 pr_update_branch") is not edited, because it is outside this card's file surface. The new line names itself as the exception to it.
